name: Inside Cube
description: The camera stands inside a cube and turns from the wall showing the first clip to the next wall showing the second. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction the view turns, snapped to its main axis (x right, y up)

params.name: fov
params.description: Field of view along the turn, in degrees

params.name: shading
params.description: How much the walls darken as they turn, and the corner shadow

params.name: background
params.description: Color of the other faces of the cube
